scenario.title: Lakeside Water — billing dispute surge (Mock #6, not an official contest problem)
scenario.description: Billing dispute tickets roughly doubled in August-September. Customer Service wants an AI agent. Field reading is contracted out; AMI meters and the meter data management system (MDMS) are run by a vendor.
scenario.initial_request: Dispute tickets doubled since August. Build an AI agent that auto-answers billing dispute tickets and fixes whatever is causing the wrong bills.

symptoms: Dispute ticket volume doubled since August
problem_definition_history.root_problem: Insufficient field route completion due to staffing shortage causes missed manual meter reads, leading to increased estimated bills and consequently higher dispute ticket volume.

interpretation_history.interpretation: The dispute ticket volume rose from ~600 in June/July to ~1,180 in August and 1,260 in September, roughly doubling since August, confirming the requester's framing that dispute tickets have doubled since August.

The observation shows that among disputed bills, 1,785 are associated with ACTUAL reads and 1,240 with ESTIMATED reads, indicating that disputed bills occur for both read types with a higher count for ACTUAL reads.

The observation shows dispute response times have a median of 1.6 days and a 90th percentile of 2.8 days, both under the 3‑day SLA, with 2,440 tickets recorded. This indicates that response delays are not a likely driver of the recent dispute surge.
The tariff change log contains no records, indicating no tariff changes were logged during the period.

structural_remedies.description: Increase field staffing by adding three meter readers to eliminate the staffing shortage (based on stakeholder statement E-06 and observed route completion below target E-05).
structural_remedies.rationale: Hiring, onboarding, and training new readers cannot be completed within the remaining 225 minutes (~3.75 hours).; residual gap: Even with added staff, route completion may still fall short of the 0.95 target if other factors (e.g., scheduling, training) limit effectiveness (unknown U-01).

structural_remedies.description: Improve estimate accuracy and reduce reliance on estimated bill substitution by updating billing import validation rules and estimate algorithms (supported by disputed bill counts for ESTIMATED reads E-02).
structural_remedies.rationale: Configuration changes to billing rules can be made quickly within the remaining time and do not violate K-BILLWRITE (no automated bill writes).; residual gap: Root cause (staffing shortage and missed manual reads) remains; only the symptom of disputed bills from estimated reads is mitigated, leaving disputes from actual reads and any residual estimation errors.

proposal.root_cause: Insufficient field route completion due to staffing shortage causes missed manual meter reads, leading to increased estimated bills and higher dispute ticket volume.

remedies.description: Increase field staffing by adding three meter readers to eliminate the staffing shortage (based on stakeholder statement E-06 and observed route completion below target E-05).
remedies.feasibility_rationale: Hiring, onboarding, and training new readers cannot be completed within the remaining 225 minutes (~3.75 hours).
remedies.residual_gap: Even with added staff, route completion may still fall short of the 0.95 target if other factors (e.g., scheduling, training) limit effectiveness (unknown U-01).

remedies.description: Improve estimate accuracy and reduce reliance on estimated bill substitution by updating billing import validation rules and estimate algorithms (supported by disputed bill counts for ESTIMATED reads E-02).
remedies.feasibility_rationale: Configuration changes to billing rules can be made quickly within the remaining time and do not violate K-BILLWRITE (no automated bill writes).
remedies.residual_gap: Root cause (staffing shortage and missed manual reads) remains; only the symptom of disputed bills from estimated reads is mitigated, leaving disputes from actual reads and any residual estimation errors.

payload.summary: Insufficient field route completion due to staffing shortage causes missed manual meter reads, leading to increased estimated bills and consequently higher dispute ticket volume.

proposal.why_agent: Deterministic rules suffice for config changes and monitoring; LLM reasoning and autonomous iteration add no value; residual exception remains that estimate accuracy improvements may not address disputes from actual reads; detection of dispute volume trend is needed.
